name: PySW Web SWF Decompiler & Editor
description: A comprehensive web-based Flash SWF Decompiler, Resource Inspector, Hex Editor, and ActionScript Editor inspired by JPEXS FFDEC. It includes binary SWF/CWS parsing, vector shape visualization, audio & image asset playback, and Gemini-powered ActionScript 3 (AVM2) decompilation and code modernizer.
